name: Arrival hall (lava window)
purpose: The first interior: shoes off, voices drop, and a wall of real lava glows through glass while a warm stream runs past the reception.

ceiling_profile.note: Carved basalt vault; timber post-and-beam bays along the south facade (9 m) rising to a rock vault over the north half (16 m). Raised from the spec's ~8 m to match the scale of concept 04 (logged).

portals.note: Stair landing door; helix starts at (90, 64.4) inside (a_start 270).
Lift door on the core's north face, reached by the 2 m strip between the core (r 8) and the north wall; bridge over the well to the car.

hero.why: A wall of moving lava behind thick glass is the reason the hall exists: it is the brightest, warmest thing in view from the door and pulls guests across the stream.

anchored.why: Carries the spine over the stream; frames the lava window from its crown.
Shoes come off at the door (lookbook); south wall left of the entrance as in 04.
Greets guests on the left after the slipper wall.
Ritual hand-washing stop on the spine just before the lift.
Single blossom tree marks the basin (ground plan).
Spiral Stair and lift at E3; doorway faces the spine.

water.note: Rises at a rock spill under the lava window (NW), runs SE under the bridge and sinks into a slot at the south wall toward B1.

sightlines.see: Lava glow filling the north-east, the bridge crown on the spine, lanterns leading to it.
The lava window across the hall, the torii framed through the open west front.
The lit spiral doorway to the east: the next space's warm light.
Lava window straight ahead across the stream (north), bridge crown on the right.

concept.match: Looking back west: torii framed through the open west front, lava window on the right, stream and rocks lower right, slipper wall and lanterns on the left, wet reflective floor.

lights.why: Warm cluster over the slipper wall, as in 04.
Pair flanking the Spiral Stair / lift doorway: the landing reads from the bridge.
Pair at the lift door on the core's north face.
Low cluster marking the changing-hall doorway (3.2 m high) on the east wall.

dressing.why: Dark silhouettes against the lava glow at each end of the window.
Bronze rail round the lift core's south face either side of the doorway (landing of spiral_stair and main_lift).
Level board beside the lift door: 地上 Ground · B1-B4.

mood.palette: amber lanterns, orange lava, teal stream, black wet stone
mood.mist: low steam over the stream only

draft_note: Lead's worked example kept except: ceiling_z from layout (16), spiral/lift portals renamed to layout ids, branches (changing halls, terrace, lift door), landing lanterns and rail, terrace sightline.

branches.note: Round the east side of the core (kept > 8 m from its centre) to the lift door at (90, 78).
Passes east of the reception counter (x 54.5-61.5) and 7 m west of the stream.
